projects.name: Smart Review Classifier
projects.description: Built a complete sentiment analysis pipeline utilizing the Amazon Fine Food Reviews dataset[cite: 62]. Cleaned the text data using Pandas, extracted features via TF-IDF vectorization, and developed a custom ensemble model (Logistic Regression and Naive Bayes) using NumPy that achieved 91.2% accuracy[cite: 63]. Deployed the model as a live interactive web application using Streamlit to showcase real-time predictions[cite: 64].
projects.faang_signal: FAANG signal: Engineering end-to-end NLP pipelines handling customer review datasets coupled with writing mathematically sound custom ensembles from scratch instead of high-level wrappers matches modern scale-intelligence paradigms.

projects.name: Lasso Regression Optimization (L1 Regularization)
projects.description: Developed a custom Lasso Regression framework from scratch to predict Olympic medal distributions, leveraging L1 regularization to induce feature sparsity and automatic variable selection. Evaluated mathematical trade-offs against Ridge Regression, mapping how the L1 penalty zeroes out redundant predictors. Benchmarked objective function minimization trajectories against scikit-learn's coordinate descent solver.
projects.faang_signal: FAANG signal: Implementing core optimization algorithms from scratch demonstrates deep mathematical intuition and algorithmic rigor over basic API consumption.

projects.name: Car Price Predictor
projects.description: Executed Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and built a rigorous data-cleaning pipeline on web-scraped automotive records from the Quikr website. Architected an end-to-end evaluation pipeline utilizing integrated Column Transformer mapping features alongside a Linear Regression model, producing an R² validation score of 0.92 on testing splits while handling skewed distributions via Interquartile Range (IQR) boundary adjustments.
projects.faang_signal: FAANG signal: Real-world data ingestion processing web-scraped distributions and utilizing advanced statistical processing handling outliers models production-grade data cleaning requirements.

projects.name: Olympic Data Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed over 120 years of historical Olympic Games records, executing comprehensive processing pipelines to sanitize structural missing data and filter duplicate profiles. Constructed an interactive browser-based visual dashboard utilizing Streamlit to map overall medal metrics and country trajectories. Conducted advanced EDA using Pandas and Seaborn to parse demographic correlations with podium success rates.
